overview_description.description: FurtherAI helps insurers by providing AI-powered assistants tailored for insurance operations. It automates repetitive tasks across workflows such as submission intake, policy comparisons, underwriting audits, claims validations, and form processing. Its system ingests unstructured documents, extracts data, flags inconsistencies, and drives interactions across internal systems or external portals. It maintains isolated data storage per client and enforces enterprise-grade security and compliance controls. Through configurable modules, it adapts to workflows in commercial insurance such as renewals, audits, and binding processes.

about_short_description.short_description: FurtherAI provides AI assistants for insurers, automating workflows like submission intake, policy comparisons, and underwriting processes.

product.name: AI Assistant
product.description: An AI tool that automates insurance document processing, data extraction, workflow automation, and communication tasks to support underwriting and claims operations.

product.name: Submissions Processing
product.description: Automates the intake, extraction, and enrichment of insurance submission documents to accelerate underwriting workflows and improve data accuracy.

product.name: Policy Comparison & Checks
product.description: Automates detailed comparisons of insurance policy documents to identify differences in coverage, exclusions, and endorsements for underwriting and compliance.

product.name: Underwriting Audit
product.description: Automates data extraction and validation in underwriting audits to reduce manual effort and improve compliance accuracy for reinsurers and insurers.
